title: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure accepted by the UE

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network initiates PDU session modification by sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, and UE accepts the modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to request PDU session modification, containing various IEs for QoS rules, EPS bearer contexts, and other parameters.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful completion of PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate PDU session modification, used for error recovery when detecting issues in mapped EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Authorized QoS rules IE
entities.description: Information element containing authorized QoS rules that UE processes sequentially during PDU session modification.

entities.name: Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE
entities.description: Information element containing mapped EPS bearer contexts that UE processes and checks for various types of errors.

entities.name: Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE
entities.description: Information element containing authorized QoS flow descriptions that UE processes sequentially during PDU session modification.

entities.name: 5GSM cause IE
entities.description: Information element containing cause values for PDU session modification requests, used when UE detects errors in mapped EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, associated with DNN or no DNN depending on PDU session establishment conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3584
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, associated with S-NSSAI and DNN combinations depending on PDU session establishment conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3585
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, associated with S-NSSAI or no S-NSSAI depending on PDU session establishment conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3581
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE when PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message contains PTI value allocated in UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition where PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message is received for an emergency PDU session, affecting timer stopping behavior.

entities.name: QoS rules replacement property
entities.description: UE replaces stored authorized QoS rules, authorized QoS flow descriptions and session-AMBR of the PDU session with received values from PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

relations.description: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.
UE completes the procedure by sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message may contain Authorized QoS rules IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message may contain Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message may contain Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE.
Upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, UE stops timer T3396 under certain conditions.
Upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, UE stops timer T3584 under certain conditions.
Upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, UE stops timer T3585 under certain conditions.
If PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message is received for emergency PDU session, UE does not stop timer T3396.
If PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message is received for emergency PDU session, UE does not stop timer T3585.
Receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message establishes that UE replaces stored authorized QoS rules with received values.
If PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message contains PTI value allocated in UE-requested procedure, UE stops timer T3581.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message includes 5GSM cause IE when UE detects errors in mapped EPS bearer contexts.
